title: Start here: preserve evidence before projection or authority
summary: CivicPort is an ooRexx public-data evidence port. The governing rule is: preserve evidence first, project later, promote never by accident. Current authoritative project head in this sphere is CivicPort v0.14; JMS is a separate transport bridge and NOTAM output remains evidence-only/non-operational.
invariants: Network transport is never world-fact authority.
Retained source evidence precedes lossy SQL/API projection.
HardWorld mutation requires an explicit promotion grant; no adapter or transport may promote by accident.
JMS connectivity, Java/BSF/JNDI and SWIFT credentials remain outside CivicPort.
The FAA/SWIM subscription represented by current fixtures is NOT_FOR_OPERATIONAL_USE; downstream surfaces must preserve that disposition.
procedure: Recover the exact current CivicPort package and validate its manifest before editing.
Read ref.civicport.current-baseline and arch.civicport.evidence-boundaries before changing a boundary.
When adding a source, pin endpoint/query/mapping generation and keep source evidence richer than projections.
When adding a consumer surface, consume already-durable evidence rather than reopening transport authority.
Re-run focused tests, the complete deterministic surface, source compilation and static boundary scans before sealing a new standalone package.

provenance.claim: Project identity and governing evidence-first rule.
